title: JANUS Linear A canonical research state after open-predecessor acquisition and R3C freeze

canonicality.rule: v2.7 preserves the complete v2.6 R3B claim ceiling and adds a separate R3C open-predecessor/same-lineage reproducibility lane. No predecessor is promoted into an independent transcription source merely because its code or analysis is independent.

high_value_methodological_predecessors: Petrolito et al. Linear A Digital Corpus 2015
open_predecessor_inventory_summary.binary_archive_rule: No local byte SHA-256 is claimed for PDFs that could be parsed through the web interface but could not be materialized as exact bytes in the current runtime.

important_new_epistemic_result.statement: There is already a substantial computational Linear A neighborhood, but the strongest open projects mostly share GORILA/Younger/lineara ancestry. They are therefore valuable external methodological controls and reproducibility targets, not substitutes for R3B independent editorial transcription.
important_new_epistemic_result.consequence: JANUS can now test whether its provenance-first typed architecture reproduces or corrects predecessor results while keeping the independent-transcription gate uncontaminated.

new_source_quality_signal.Briakos_metadata_vs_PDF: secondary repository metadata disagreed with the thesis PDF on Cohen's d (0.692 vs 0.623); JANUS preserved the first intake and issued a corrective receipt rather than silently overwriting it
new_source_quality_signal.logos_lineara_defects: external D5/D6 findings demonstrate that surface boundary handling and sign-label/glyph identity need explicit generic safeguards in JANUS transcription IR

next_atomic_requirements.action: Reconstruct and freeze Briakos corpus selection/tokenization/statistic definitions from the public thesis before computing results on the JANUS frozen mwenge commit.
Replay D5/D6 as externally seeded conformance tests and harden the generic transcription substrate without claiming JANUS discovery credit.
Continue searching for or lawfully acquire exact alternate-editorial source bytes; R3B remains independently blocked until this occurs.

highest_admissible_claim: JANUS has now mapped and frozen a substantial open computational Linear A predecessor ecosystem and created a separate R3C same-lineage reproducibility lane with a pre-execution contamination firewall. Exact public Git identities from logos, the Nepal/Perono code repository and the Sakamoto structural project are frozen; public scholarly content from Briakos, Braovic, Petrolito and Nepal/Perono is available for method reconstruction. The intake also localized a repository-metadata/PDF discrepancy in Briakos and registered logos D5/D6 lineara.xyz defects as external prior art. None of this supplies the independent alternate-editorial transcription bytes required by R3B, establishes a new anchor, or constitutes a decipherment.
